compound_ladder.label: calibrated (0.21% of lap time)
compound_ladder.derivation: fresh-tyre step prior 0.225 s (calibrated (0.21% of lap time)). The races identify the *net* cost of one step harder over a whole stint, holding stint length and race phase fixed: Spa-Francorchamps 2024 -0.043 +/- 0.186 s [not used: standard error 0.186 s > 0.15 s (pre-2026 measurement, too imprecise to pool)]; australia-2026 +0.317 +/- 0.345 s; japan-2026 -0.069 +/- 0.664 s; barcelona-2026 +0.060 +/- 0.336 s; austria-2026 +0.106 +/- 0.295 s; hungary-2026 -0.010 +/- 0.327 s; italy-2026 +0.173 +/- 0.354 s -> pooled +0.115 +/- 0.144 s per step. The model's fresh-tyre offsets are calibrated so that, with its own degradation ladder, it reproduces this net at the stint length it recommends.

explanation: OCO: 1-stop M-S @ 16; BEA: 1-stop M-S @ 16 - the same first stop (lap 16); the same plan shape
S2 degradation: OCO +0.0768 vs BEA +0.0039 s/lap of age (+0.0729); it says *where* the loss is, and enters no cost [OCO: n=7, w=0.37, team | BEA: n=7, w=0.37, team]

pace level: OCO 0.604 s/lap vs BEA 0.315 s/lap (+0.289); the quicker car reaches any given gap to the car ahead sooner, which moves the lap its stop is worth taking [OCO: n=7, w=0.47, team | BEA: n=6, w=0.43, team]
S3 degradation: OCO +0.0258 vs BEA +0.0112 s/lap of age (+0.0146); it says *where* the loss is, and enters no cost [OCO: n=7, w=0.37, team | BEA: n=7, w=0.37, team]

consistency: OCO 0.73 s vs BEA 0.54 s (+0.191); a wider spread about the stint trend is uncertainty, not a cost: it widens the window rather than moving the lap [OCO: n=6, w=0.33, team | BEA: n=5, w=0.29, team]

race-history rate factor (from previous races, not this weekend's evidence): OCO x1.061 vs BEA x1.116 after precision shrinkage (raw x1.102 / x1.197, ln_sd 0.07874769551042335 / 0.08024508750009411); it scales the whole rate, so the higher factor stops earlier
degradation on SOFT: OCO 0.1516 vs BEA 0.1462 s/lap of age (+0.0054); OCO pays 0.1 s more than BEA over a 25-lap stint, which pulls its stop earlier [OCO: n=7, w=0.26, team | BEA: n=6, w=0.23, team]
the two recommendations agree: the differences above are not big enough to separate the plans
